summary_1line: Bhima is captured by a cursed serpent who reveals himself as King Nahusha, while ominous signs alert Yudhishthira that calamity has befallen his brother.

image_candidates.scene_text: A gigantic serpent coils tightly around Bhima in the forest, leaving his arms free as the mighty warrior struggles in fury.
The cursed serpent speaks while wrapped around Bhima, revealing he is the fallen king Nahusha awaiting release from Agastya’s curse.
In the hermitage clearing, Yudhishthira sees jackals howl and strange one‑winged birds vomit blood beneath a darkening sky of ill omens.
